name: Stack Slant Shift
formation: Two-Gap Front vs Under-Center 21 Strong Right

summary.motive: Disguise instant penetration inside a patient two-gap stance, then send all three linemen across blockers’ faces at once so every combo chases while linebackers replace behind.
summary.keyDefender: NG shooting across center into strong A — he lands exactly in the lead-blocker geometry of any strong-side run
summary.whyItWorks: Simultaneous inward movement turns every committed down block into a chase, and replacing linebackers guarantee the abandoned gaps stay occupied.
summary.failureMode: Reach blocks hooking the slanting ends outward, springing the exact gaps the slant walked away from.

beats.title: 1. The Patient Stack Bait
beats.text: The interior trio sits squared in two-gap stances inviting double teams — the offense commits its combos against defenders who are about to leave.

beats.title: 2. Three Bodies Cross Inward
beats.text: Nose and both ends explode across their blockers’ faces simultaneously, collapsing into the A and B gaps before any combo can climb or adjust.

beats.title: 3. Linebackers Replace Behind the Slant
beats.text: Both inside backers fill the gaps the slant abandoned — no vacated space ever exists even though three linemen just moved.

beats.title: 4. Head-On in Strong B
beats.text: The lead blocker arrives to find the slanting nose already in his aiming point while the squeezing edge funnels the carrier into the pile.

relations.tell: The interior trio tilts and staggers its steps during the cadence before exploding inward — base two-gap fits sit flat-footed reading blocks.
